business_overview.revenue_model: Export-oriented beauty product and beauty bag manufacturing/sales to retailers, brand owners and trading companies; revenue is recognized from product sales and customers may transact in cash or on credit.
business_notes: 2025 revenue was HKD 161.678m, down 13.5% year on year in the annual review extraction.
Major markets disclosed for 2025 include USA HKD 56.939m, United Kingdom HKD 36.410m, Ireland HKD 44.775m and other regions HKD 23.554m.
Major customers each contributing at least 10% of revenue were material; extracted owner-earnback report records customers A/B/C at HKD 41.592m, HKD 44.774m and HKD 28.716m.
